Rewa Collector Inspects Hospital, Expresses Anger Over Poor Conditions

Rewa Collector Narendra Suryavanshi conducted a surprise inspection of Sanjay Gandhi Hospital in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, late on Monday night. He became angry upon observing the hospital's disarray and poor sanitation. The collector reportedly ordered the salary of the in-charge to be cut for seven days due to the conditions. A video of the collector expressing his displeasure has emerged.
